description: This file defines classes and methods for managing sale and packing journals, invoice types, and related workflows in an OpenERP/Odoo module.

classes.name: sale_journal_invoice_type
classes.description: Defines invoice types with attributes like name, active status, note, and invoicing method.

classes.name: sale_journal
classes.description: Represents a sale journal with attributes such as name, code, responsible user, dates, state, and associated sale stats. Includes methods for workflow actions like cancel, confirm, open, draft, and close.

classes.name: picking_journal
classes.description: Represents a packing (picking) journal with attributes similar to sale journal, including methods for workflow actions like cancel, open, draft, and close.

methods.name: button_sale_cancel
methods.description: Cancels draft sale orders linked to the sale journal using workflow triggers.

methods.name: button_sale_confirm
methods.description: Confirms draft sale orders linked to the sale journal using workflow triggers.

methods.name: button_close
methods.description: Marks the journal as 'done' and sets the validation date.

methods.name: button_picking_cancel
methods.description: Cancels stock pickings linked to the picking journal using workflow triggers.

methods.name: button_open
methods.description: Sets the picking journal's state to 'open'.

methods.name: button_draft
methods.description: Sets the picking journal's state to 'draft'.

methods.name: button_close
methods.description: Marks the picking journal as 'done' and sets the validation date.
